name: Hailo-10H M.2 AI Acceleration Module Product Page
notes: Official Hailo product page for Hailo-10H M.2 module. Specifies 40 TOPS INT4 / 20 TOPS INT8, 2.5W typical power consumption, M.2 Key M (2242, 2280) form factor, PCIe Gen3.0 x4 interface, and 4|8GB LPDDR4/4X memory capacity. Memory bus width and bandwidth are not published on the page.
